name: fastembed-server
description: Multi-strategy FastEmbed server (Dense, ColBERT, Rerank) using FastAPI.

scripts.start:dense: conda run --no-capture-output -n doc-ingestion python server.py --strategy dense
scripts.start:colbert: conda run --no-capture-output -n doc-ingestion python server.py --strategy late_interaction
scripts.start:rerank: conda run --no-capture-output -n doc-ingestion python server.py --strategy rerank
scripts.start:dense:gpu: conda run --no-capture-output -n doc-ingestion python server.py --strategy dense --gpu
scripts.start:colbert:gpu: conda run --no-capture-output -n doc-ingestion python server.py --strategy late_interaction --gpu
